puzzle.hint: The delightful reward awaiting the righteous believers in the Hereafter.
puzzle.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍۢ يُحْبَرُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
